scope: Same CPU physical kernels/inputs; split AD driver and derivative rules are compared
rss_scope: Maximum observed worker VmHWM/VmRSS, 10 ms polling; fresh process per model/implementation; includes compilation and execution, not a warm-only peak
buffer_scope: XLA executable argument/output/temporary bytes minus aliases; separate from process RSS

checkpoint_strategy.source: Sparse accepted forward state/FSAL nodes plus pre-kick endpoints
checkpoint_strategy.excludes: RK transposes, initial FSAL linearizations and rejected forward work

regression_checks.explanation: 134 RK checks completed before a newly extended split-test diagnostic reused its save-time name; that test-only name was corrected and all 49 split/kinetic checks rerun successfully.

timing_method_note: Fresh isolated processes, each compiled and warmed before 21 samples. A diagnostic same-process module-reload comparison gave inconsistent fused GC times; it was not used for the final timing table. No particle chunks.
